scenario.summary: This article describes multiple Metasploit modules targeting vulnerabilities in Langflow and OpenCTI, providing unauthenticated remote code execution capabilities. In Langflow environments, successful exploitation allows attackers to execute arbitrary Python code, access application secrets, pivot to cloud metadata services, and maintain persistence by injecting malicious code into the application's database.

meta.hypothesis: An attacker is exploiting unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerabilities in Langflow AI endpoints and subsequently querying the cloud metadata service to harvest identity tokens for lateral movement.

hunt.name: Langflow RCE and Cloud Metadata Discovery
hunt.description: This hunt identifies Langflow installations within the estate and monitors for exploitation attempts against the build and validate API endpoints. It correlates these suspicious HTTP requests with outbound traffic to the cloud metadata service (169.254.169.254), a common post-exploitation step used to pivot from a compromised container or instance into the cloud control plane. The hunt uses a stack-counting baseline to isolate rare external actors hitting these sensitive AI orchestration paths.

config.scoping_notes: Begin by searching the software inventory for Langflow. If the inventory is stale, run the HTTP queries across all application server subnets.
config.beyond_detection: A simple detection rule might trigger on any metadata access, but this hunt correlates the presence of vulnerable AI software with specific unauthenticated HTTP paths and applies a baseline to ignore frequent internal scanners.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version, install_path FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%langflow%'
config.description: Locate hosts running Langflow to establish the hunt scope.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts and their Langflow versions. Silence means the product is not recorded in the package inventory.

primitive_config.label: Identify Langflow Installations
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version, install_path FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%langflow%'
primitive_config.expected: A list of hosts and their Langflow versions. Silence means the product is not recorded in the package inventory.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, url_path, status_code, user_agent, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/api/v1/build%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/api/v1/validate%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%eval_custom_component_code%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find HTTP requests to the Langflow endpoints targeted by the Metasploit modules.
config.expected_signal: Requests to sensitive build or validate endpoints. Frequent 200 OK responses from unusual source IPs indicate potential successful exploitation.

primitive_config.label: Detect Suspicious API Calls
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, url_path, status_code, user_agent, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/api/v1/build%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/api/v1/validate%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%eval_custom_component_code%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Requests to sensitive build or validate endpoints. Frequent 200 OK responses from unusual source IPs indicate potential successful exploitation.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, url_full, user_agent, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (url_hostname = '{{metadata_ip}}' OR dst_endpoint_ip = '{{metadata_ip}}') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify attempts to reach the cloud metadata service from the same hosts.
config.expected_signal: Outbound HTTP requests to the metadata service. This is anomalous for standard AI workflow builder operations and suggests credential theft.

primitive_config.label: Detect Metadata Access
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, url_full, user_agent, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (url_hostname = '{{metadata_ip}}' OR dst_endpoint_ip = '{{metadata_ip}}') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Outbound HTTP requests to the metadata service. This is anomalous for standard AI workflow builder operations and suggests credential theft.

config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, COUNT(*) AS request_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/api/v1/build%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/api/v1/validate%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY src_endpoint_ip HAVING host_count <= 3 ORDER BY host_count ASC
config.description: Stack-count source IPs to isolate rare external actors hitting Langflow endpoints.
config.expected_signal: A list of source IPs hitting Langflow on 3 or fewer hosts. High-volume, fleet-wide traffic usually indicates internal health checks or automated scanners.
